dialogue.content: こんばんは。時間ですが…
dialogue.English: Good evening. It's time now...

dialogue.content: 申し訳ございません、パソコンから入れず、遅くなりました。
dialogue.English: I'm terribly sorry, I had trouble logging in from my computer and am running late.

dialogue.content: はじめます。こんばんは、相談員です。
dialogue.English: Let’s begin. Good evening, I’m the counselor.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you in advance.

dialogue.content: 息子のことで困っています
dialogue.English: I’m having trouble with my son.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: I'm here to help.

dialogue.content: それは心配ですね…
dialogue.English: That must be worrying...

dialogue.content: どんなことがあったのですか？
dialogue.English: What has been happening?

dialogue.content: 反抗期がひどくてどう対応していいのかわかりません
dialogue.English: His rebellious phase is severe, and I don't know how to handle it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね…それは困ってしまいますよね…
dialogue.English: I see... That must be very troubling for you...

dialogue.content: お子様はおいくつですか？
dialogue.English: How old is your son?

dialogue.content: 中3です
dialogue.English: He's in the third year of junior high.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。心配になりますね…どんなことがあったのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be concerning... What sort of things have happened?

dialogue.content: もともと無口な子なんですが、ちょっと話しかけるだけで怒りだすんです
dialogue.English: He's always been a quiet child, but now he gets angry just from me trying to talk to him a little.

dialogue.content: それはどうしたらいいんだろうと悩んでしまいますよね…
dialogue.English: That must leave you wondering what to do...

dialogue.content: 最近はやっと学校が始まったので家にいることは少なくなってきて安心してます
dialogue.English: School has finally started recently, so he's home less often, which is a relief.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it has been.

dialogue.content: お子さんはどんなことで怒るのですか？
dialogue.English: What sorts of things does your son get angry about?

dialogue.content: 今年、受験生なのでまず志望校のこととかを話そうとすると、機嫌をそこねてしまって。
dialogue.English: He's preparing for high school entrance exams this year, so when I try to talk about his preferred schools, he gets into a bad mood.

dialogue.content: 部屋にとじこもって、しまうんです
dialogue.English: He ends up shutting himself in his room.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね、それはお子さんの気持ちを考えると心配になりますよね…
dialogue.English: I understand. That must make you worry about how your son is feeling...

dialogue.content: 部屋にはいると、物が飛んできたり…
dialogue.English: When I go into his room, things get thrown...

dialogue.content: おお、それは…
dialogue.English: Oh, that's...

dialogue.content: 機嫌が悪いと壁を蹴ったりして…
dialogue.English: When he's in a bad mood, he kicks the walls...

dialogue.content: そうですか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 手をつけられないというか…
dialogue.English: It's like I can't handle him...

dialogue.content: そうですよね、お子さんの気持ちわからなくなってしまいますよね…
dialogue.English: Yes, it must feel like you don't understand your son's feelings anymore...

dialogue.content: そうなんです。
dialogue.English: That's exactly it.

dialogue.content: 志望校のことはどんなことをお話しされるんですか？
dialogue.English: When you talk about prospective schools, what kinds of things do you bring up?

dialogue.content: まだ将来が見えてなくて
dialogue.English: He doesn't have a clear vision for the future yet.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: どこに行きたいのか希望も聞けていないです
dialogue.English: I haven’t even been able to hear his preferences, like where he wants to go.

dialogue.content: なるほど…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: こんな状況だからこそ、お子様のこと心配ですよね。
dialogue.English: It's precisely because of this situation that you're worried about your son, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうなんですよ。
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: ご相談者さんは(どのようにお呼びしましょうか？)お子様の将来をどのようにお考えなんですか？
dialogue.English: How would you like me to address you? What are your thoughts on your son's future?

dialogue.content: あまり口うるさくは言いたくないんですけど、ある程度は進路をどうするか聞いておかないといけないかと思って
dialogue.English: I don't want to be too pushy, but I feel I need to ask him to some extent about his plans for his future path.

dialogue.content: 林です
dialogue.English: My name is Hayashi.

dialogue.content: 林さんですね。そうですよね、お子様自身のお考え知りたいですよね。
dialogue.English: Ms. Hayashi. I understand, you want to know what your son himself is thinking, don't you?

dialogue.content: 息子の気持ちをある程度は尊重したいと思っています
dialogue.English: I want to respect my son's feelings to some extent.

dialogue.content: 部活が盛んなところにいきたいとか、勉強を頑張るとか何かあればいいんですけど
dialogue.English: I wish he had some preference, like wanting to go to a school with strong clubs or wanting to focus on his studies—something to go on.

dialogue.content: それもわからなくて
dialogue.English: But I don’t even know that.

dialogue.content: そうですか…それでしたら志望校についてなおさらお話ししたいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see... In that case, you must want to talk about his choice of school all the more.

dialogue.content: お話しできない状況なのですね…
dialogue.English: But you're in a situation where you can't talk about it...

dialogue.content: 今年は始まったばかりなのでまだ先なのかもしれないですけど…
dialogue.English: The school year has just begun, so maybe it's still early, but...

dialogue.content: えぇ、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: 学校説明会とかに行かないといけない情報を知人から聞いて、
dialogue.English: I heard from an acquaintance that we need to go to school information sessions and things like that,

dialogue.content: ただただ焦るばかりです
dialogue.English: and I'm just getting more and more anxious.

dialogue.content: なるほど…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: お子様が心配だからこそ、何かやってあげなきゃという気持ちになりますよね…
dialogue.English: It's precisely because you're worried about your son that you feel you have to do something for him, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 同級生で志望校が決まってる人もいるらしく…
dialogue.English: Apparently, some of his classmates have already decided on their preferred schools...

dialogue.content: 子どもに聞いても教えてくれないんですよね
dialogue.English: Even when I ask my son, he won’t tell me.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…それは余計に焦ってしまいますよね…
dialogue.English: I see... That must make you feel even more anxious...

dialogue.content: お子さんがよく怒るようになったのはいつ頃からですか？
dialogue.English: About when did your son start getting angry so often?

dialogue.content: 今年に入って、学年が変わってからでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Since the start of this year, perhaps after he moved up a grade?

dialogue.content: 常にピリピリしてます…
dialogue.English: He’s always on edge...

dialogue.content: そうですか…林さんも、その様子を見ているとソワソワしてしまいますね…
dialogue.English: I see... Ms. Hayashi, watching that must leave you feeling on edge as well...

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 志望校以外のことは何かお話しされますか？
dialogue.English: Do you talk about things other than his choice of school?

dialogue.content: 受験とは関係ない話をするようにしていても怒っています
dialogue.English: Even when I try to talk about topics unrelated to the exams, he gets angry.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 部活のこととか聞いたりします
dialogue.English: I ask him about his club activities and things like that.

dialogue.content: 部活はどんなことをされてらっしゃるんですか？
dialogue.English: What kind of club activities is he involved in?

dialogue.content: バドミントンです
dialogue.English: Badminton.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、どんなことをお話しされるんですか？
dialogue.English: I see. What kinds of things do you talk about?

dialogue.content: 新入生はどのくらい入った？とか部活はどんなことやってるのか？とかですね
dialogue.English: Things like, 'How many new students joined?' or 'What do you do in the club?' and so on.

dialogue.content: 林さんは一生懸命話しかけてるんですね…
dialogue.English: You’re making a sincere effort to talk with him, Ms. Hayashi...

dialogue.content: そうですね。コミュニケーションとったほうがいいかと思って
dialogue.English: Yes. I thought it would be better to communicate.

dialogue.content: でも、空回りしてる感じです
dialogue.English: But it feels like I’m just spinning my wheels.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…報われないようで悲しくなってしまいますね
dialogue.English: I see... It must be sad to feel like your efforts aren't paying off.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That’s right.

dialogue.content: めげずに話そうとはするんですが、無視されることもしょっちゅうで。
dialogue.English: I try not to get discouraged and keep talking to him, but I’m often ignored.

dialogue.content: それは…悲しいですね
dialogue.English: That is... painful.

dialogue.content: 以前はお子さんとはどんな関係だったのですか？
dialogue.English: What was your relationship with your son like before?

dialogue.content: 話しかけたらちゃんと答えてくれました
dialogue.English: When I talked to him, he would answer properly.

dialogue.content: 怒ることもあまりなくて…
dialogue.English: He rarely got angry...

dialogue.content: 物静かな感じです
dialogue.English: He was the quiet type.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: それは余計ギャップを感じて心配になりますね
dialogue.English: That must make the contrast feel even greater and make you more worried.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it does.

dialogue.content: お子さんについてどなたかにご相談されましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you talked to anyone about your son?

dialogue.content: 主人には相談しました
dialogue.English: I've talked to my husband.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: どんなお話しをされたんですか？
dialogue.English: What did you talk about?

dialogue.content: 主人は楽観的な人で、
dialogue.English: My husband is an optimistic person,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そういう年頃なんだよ、とあっさりしていました
dialogue.English: He just casually said, 'He's at that age.'

dialogue.content: 少し放っておいたほうがいいと言います
dialogue.English: He says it's better to leave him alone for a bit.

dialogue.content: なるほど…それは一人で悩んでいるようで孤独を感じてしまいますね
dialogue.English: I see... That must make you feel like you're worrying all by yourself, and feel very lonely.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご主人以外にはどなたかにお話しされましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you spoken to anyone besides your husband?

dialogue.content: 今は主人だけです。あまりひどくなってきたら、学校の先生に相談しようかと思っています
dialogue.English: Right now, it's just my husband. If it gets much worse, I’m thinking of talking to his school teachers.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 林さん、ご主人も楽観的とのこと、一人で悩まれて苦しかったですね
dialogue.English: Ms. Hayashi, with your husband being so optimistic, it must have been difficult to worry about this all by yourself.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it has been.

dialogue.content: どうしていいのかわからなぬて
dialogue.English: I just don’t know what to do.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 林さん、いままでのお話を整理させていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Ms. Hayashi, would it be all right if I summarize what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 林さんは、中三の息子さんのことで悩まれてらっしゃいます
dialogue.English: You're worried about your son, who is in his third year of junior high.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 学年が変わってから、何を言っても怒る息子さんの気持ちが分からず
dialogue.English: Since he moved up a grade, your son gets angry no matter what you say, and you haven’t been able to understand how he’s feeling,

dialogue.content: 部活やほかにも話しかけるけれども、壁をけったり物が飛んで来たりでどうしたらいいかわからないと困っています
dialogue.English: You try talking to him about his club activities and other things, but you're at a loss because he kicks walls or throws things.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That’s right.

dialogue.content: 特に志望校のことについては、心配しているのにお話しできていない状態かと思いました。
dialogue.English: Especially regarding his choice of school, although you’re concerned, you haven’t been able to talk about it.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご主人に相談してもそういう時期だからといわれ、ますますどうしたらいいかわからなくなったのではと思います
dialogue.English: And when you consulted your husband, he said it’s just that age, which I imagine left you even more unsure about what to do.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なんだか自分が空回りしているようで報われない感じがしているのでは…と思いますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: And I sense you might be feeling that you're just spinning your wheels, and that your efforts are unrewarded... Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 今まで心配しても報われない感じがして、一人で悩んで本当に苦しかったと思います
dialogue.English: Feeling that your concern has gone unrewarded and worrying all by yourself must have been truly difficult.

dialogue.content: 林さん、お話を伺って私が思ったことをお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Ms. Hayashi, would it be okay if I shared a thought I had while listening to you?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 林さんは、本当に息子さん思いで素敵な方だと思いました
dialogue.English: I think you are a wonderful person who truly cares about your son.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 無視されても一生懸命話しかけ、どうすれば力になれるかお考えになる姿は、愛情を感じます。
dialogue.English: The way you keep trying to talk to him even when ignored, and think about how you can support him, shows your love.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一方で、お子様の姿に林さん自身も焦りを感じ、他の方が志望校に決まったと聞いて不安に思われたのではないでしょうか
dialogue.English: On the other hand, seeing your son this way has also made you feel anxious, and hearing that others have decided on their schools probably made you feel uneasy.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How does that sound?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: お子様のことを大切に思うからこそですね。
dialogue.English: It’s precisely because you care so deeply about your son.

dialogue.content: ここはご提案なのですが
dialogue.English: If I may, I have a suggestion.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 林さんが今の状況から抜け出せるよう一緒に考えたいのですがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I would like to think together with you about how you can get through this current situation. Would that be okay?

dialogue.content: そうですね。よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Yes, please. I would appreciate your help.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: (時間になってしまいました…)
dialogue.English: (It seems we're out of time...)

dialogue.content: （そうですね）
dialogue.English: (Oh, yes.)

dialogue.content: (大変勉強になりました。ありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (This was a very educational experience. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well.)

dialogue.content: (ロールプレイ終了いたします。)
dialogue.English: (This concludes the role-play.)

dialogue.content: (お疲れさまでした)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)
